company: jobgether
title: Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead
options: France [remote]
description:
Our partner is looking for a Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead based in France.
In a fast-paced, fully remote environment, your work will directly influence conversion rates, customer retention, and recurring revenue.
[under: Requirements] - Experimentation and Analytics: Solid understanding of A/B testing principles, including sample sizes, primary success metrics, and minimum detectable or practically meaningful effects. Ability to interpret results and make evidence-based decisions.
[under: Requirements] - Preferred Qualifications: Experience with hybrid self-service and sales-led funnels; hands-on knowledge of CRM systems such as HubSpot or Pipedrive and email marketing platforms; experience developing prompts or knowledge bases for AI sales or support agents; and familiarity with custom manufacturing, branded merchandise, or print-on-demand businesses.
[under: Benefits] - Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere globally, with flexible working hours and no requirement to report to a physical office.
[under: Benefits] - Full-Time Engagement: An exclusive, full-time independent contractor arrangement offering substantial responsibility and autonomy.
[under: How Jobgether works] This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR).

company: jobgether
title: App Security Expert
options: Italy [remote]
description:
Our partner is looking for an App Security Expert based in Italy.
You will also contribute to advancing AI-powered static analysis and agent-based security architectures.
Working in a remote, technically driven environment, you will collaborate with security specialists to refine testing methodologies and improve evaluation quality.
[under: Accountabilities] - Contribute to the design and evaluation of security architectures for traditional applications and agent-based systems.
[under: Requirements] - Experience designing or evaluating security architectures for traditional software applications and agent-based systems.
[under: Requirements] - Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality contributions in a fully remote environment.
[under: Benefits] - Fully remote work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world.
[under: Benefits] - Long-term contract: Initial 12-month engagement, offering the opportunity to contribute to ongoing security evaluation initiatives.
[under: Benefits] - Flexible independent engagement: Work as a freelancer or independent contractor.
[under: Benefits] - Cutting-edge technical challenges: Work on application security, LLM vulnerabilities, AI-powered security analysis, and agent-based architectures.
[under: Benefits] - Collaborative remote environment: Share expertise, exchange technical feedback, and contribute to continuous improvements alongside other security professionals.
[under: How Jobgether works] This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR).
